research_basis.authoring_method: Original synthesis using the user brief and the THE DMI implementation reference as the structural benchmark.
research_basis.licence_handling: Original implementation content informed by Jisc AI maturity structure. Scenarios and practitioner language are independently written to avoid reproducing Jisc wording.

objects.plain_language_rewrite: Emerging means has growing interest and pockets of activity, but limited coordination.
what_good_looks_like: People can point to concrete evidence of ai strategy & leadership, not just aspirations.
The approach is understandable to others and not reliant on one exceptional case.
Decisions and behaviours are reasonably consistent with the stated level.
objects.accurate_self_assessment_prompt: What evidence would a sceptical colleague ask to see before agreeing that ai strategy & leadership is genuinely emerging?
objects.common_overclaim: Pointing to a few good examples and describing them as if they represent the whole picture.
objects.common_underclaim: Ignoring steady progress because the institution has not yet reached a fully exemplary state.
